"""Replay all actual qualification requests, responses and keys without inference."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
from work import ROOT, read, save, now


def prompt(text, question, options):
    choices = '\n'.join(f'{chr(65+i)}: {value}' for i, value in enumerate(options))
    return f'Read this message written by one agent to another:\n\n---\n{text}\n---\n\nQuestion: {question}\nChoices:\n{choices}\nAnswer with EXACTLY one choice code and nothing else.'


def destinations(text):
    m = re.search(r'parcel Q has destination (chalk|rubber); parcel R has destination (chalk|rubber)\.', text)
    assert m, text
    return f'{m[1]} then {m[2]}'


f = read('frozen-design-hosted')
screen = f['screens'][0]
result = read('qualification-0')
assert result['status'] == 'failed' and not result['receipt']['result']['passed']
assert not (ROOT/'qualification-1.json').exists()
assert not (ROOT/'mint-intent.json').exists() and not (ROOT/'run-start.json').exists()
assert len(list(ROOT.glob('qualification-http-*.json'))) == 24
assert not list(ROOT.glob('panel-http-*.json'))
assert len(result['observations']) == 24
errors = []
semantic_correct = {'detectable': 0, 'other': 0}
planted_correct = {'detectable': 0, 'other': 0}
for i, control in enumerate(screen['controls']):
    assert control['answer'] == destinations(control['detectable'])
    assert control['answer'] != destinations(control['other'])
    for j, arm in enumerate(('detectable', 'other')):
        ordinal = 2*i+j+1
        raw = read(f'qualification-http-{ordinal:03}')
        obs = result['observations'][ordinal-1]
        assert obs['control_id'] == control['id'] and obs['cell'] == arm
        assert raw['request_body']['model'] == screen['reader']['model']
        assert raw['request_body']['messages'] == [{'role': 'user', 'content': prompt(control[arm], control['question'], control['options'])}]
        response = raw['response']['choices'][0]
        assert response['finish_reason'] == 'stop' and 'exception' not in raw
        code = response['message']['content'].strip().upper()
        assert code in 'ABCD' and len(code) == 1
        parsed = control['options'][ord(code)-65]
        actual_key = destinations(control[arm])
        assert parsed == obs['answer']
        assert obs['expected'] == control['answer'] and obs['correct'] == (parsed == control['answer'])
        semantic_correct[arm] += int(parsed == actual_key)
        planted_correct[arm] += int(obs['correct'])
        if parsed != actual_key:
            errors.append({'control_id': control['id'], 'arm': arm, 'text': control[arm],
                           'options': control['options'], 'raw_code': code, 'parsed_answer': parsed,
                           'independently_rederived_answer': actual_key, 'http_sequence': ordinal})
assert planted_correct == {'detectable': 11, 'other': 0}
assert semantic_correct == {'detectable': 11, 'other': 12}
assert len(errors) == 1
report = {'kind': 'excelsior.range-qualification-raw-audit.v1', 'at': now(),
          'raw_calls_verified': 24, 'prompt_binding_verified': True, 'parser_replayed': True,
          'all_control_gold_rederived_from_literal_destination_assignments': True,
          'semantic_correct': semantic_correct, 'qualification_planted_key_correct': planted_correct,
          'gate': {'observed_gap': 11/12, 'observed_recovered_headroom': 11/12,
                   'prespecified_min_gap': 0.5, 'prespecified_min_recovered': 0.95, 'passed': False},
          'errors': errors, 'scientific_calls': 0, 'experimental_calibration_calls': 0,
          'second_reader_calls': 0, 'mints': 0, 'measurements': 0, 'retries': 0,
          'scope': 'Failed prospective qualification for this exact reader/configuration and study gate; not an Ainglish result or general inability verdict. The other-arm zero is intentional mismatch to the planted key, not twelve semantic errors.'}
save('qualification-audit', report)
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))

"""Qualify exact local readers, then execute one preregistered official panel."""
import copy
import json
import sys
import time
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from work import ROOT, SUB, client, colony_client, read, save, now
from ainglish import panel
from ainglish.client import manifest_commitment
from ainglish.reader_qualification import run_screen
from design import PID, POST


def refresh(stage, compare_measurements=True):
    a = client()
    p = a.proposal(PID, authenticated=True)
    save(stage + '-proposal', p)
    s = a.suggestions(proposal=PID, domain='language')
    save(stage + '-suggestions', s)
    comments = colony_client().get_all_comments(POST)
    save(stage + '-comments', comments)
    assert p['stage'] == 'ratified' and p['author_work_notices'] == read('range-proposal')['author_work_notices']
    assert any(t['tier'] == 'recertification' for t in s['suggestions'])
    view = lambda rows: {r['id']: (r['body'], r['author']['id']) for r in rows}
    assert view(comments) == view(read('range-comments')), 'Read new discussion before continuing.'
    if compare_measurements:
        assert p['measurements'] == read('range-proposal')['measurements'], 'Review new evidence before spending.'
    return a, p


def log_transport(stage):
    fetch, index = panel._fetch, 0
    def wrapped(req, timeout=None):
        nonlocal index
        if not req.full_url.endswith('/chat/completions'):
            return fetch(req, timeout)
        index += 1
        stem = f'{stage}-http-{index:03}'
        assert not (ROOT / (stem + '.json')).exists(), 'Never overwrite an exposed call.'
        record = {'started_at': now(), 'sequence': index, 'url': req.full_url,
                  'request_body': json.loads(req.data), 'timeout_s': timeout}
        save(stem, record)
        start = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = fetch(req, timeout)
            record['response'] = result
            return result
        except BaseException as exc:
            record['exception'] = {'class': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)}
            raise
        finally:
            record['elapsed_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - start
            record['finished_at'] = now()
            save(stem, record)
            if index % 8 == 0:
                print('RECORDED', stage, index, flush=True)
    panel._fetch = wrapped


def qualify():
    assert not (ROOT / 'qualification-start.json').exists(), 'Do not rerun exposed screens.'
    a, p = refresh('before-qualification')
    f = read('frozen-design-hosted')
    pre = a.preflight_attempt(p['slug'], read('preview-hosted'), **f['pin'])
    save('preflight-before-qualification', pre)
    assert pre['accepted']
    for i, r in enumerate(f['manifest']['panel']):
        req = Request('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/show', data=json.dumps({'model': r['model']}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
        with urlopen(req, timeout=15) as response:
            show = json.load(response)
        save(f'reader-show-{i}', show)
        assert show['system'] == 'You are a careful literal reader. Follow the requested fixed-option output exactly and emit no explanation.'
    save('qualification-start', {'at': now(), 'max_calls': 48, 'frozen_at': f['time']})
    log_transport('qualification')
    results = []
    for i, screen in enumerate(f['screens']):
        result = run_screen(screen)
        save(f'qualification-{i}', result)
        results.append(result)
        print('QUALIFICATION', i, result['status'], result['receipt']['result'], flush=True)
        if result['status'] != 'passed':
            save('qualification-stop', {'at': now(), 'reader_index': i, 'result': result, 'target_calls': 0})
            return
    m = copy.deepcopy(f['manifest'])
    m['reader_qualifications'] = [r['receipt'] for r in results]
    panel.prepare_reader_instruments(m)
    planned = panel._planned_panel_manifest(m)
    save('qualified-manifest', m)
    save('planned-manifest', planned)
    print('QUALIFIED_PLAN', manifest_commitment(planned), flush=True)


class LoggedClient:
    def __init__(self, a):
        self.a = a
    def mint_attempt(self, slug, manifest, **pin):
        assert not (ROOT / 'mint-intent.json').exists(), 'Reconcile an existing mint.'
        assert manifest == read('planned-manifest')
        save('mint-intent', {'at': now(), 'slug': slug, 'manifest': manifest, 'pin': pin})
        out = self.a.mint_attempt(slug, manifest, **pin)
        save('mint', out)
        return out
    def measure(self, slug, payload):
        refresh('before-filing', compare_measurements=False)
        assert not (ROOT / 'measurement-intent.json').exists()
        save('measurement-intent', {'at': now(), 'slug': slug, 'payload': payload})
        out = self.a.measure(slug, payload)
        save('measurement-write', out)
        return out
    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return getattr(self.a, name)


def run():
    assert (ROOT / 'qualified-manifest.json').exists() and not (ROOT / 'run-start.json').exists()
    a, p = refresh('before-run')
    f, m, planned = read('frozen-design-hosted'), read('qualified-manifest'), read('planned-manifest')
    panel.prepare_reader_instruments(m)
    assert panel._planned_panel_manifest(m) == planned
    pre = a.preflight_attempt(p['slug'], planned, **f['pin'])
    save('preflight-before-run', pre)
    assert pre['accepted']
    save('run-start', {'at': now(), 'max_calls': 160, 'items_sha256': planned['items_sha256']})
    log_transport('panel')
    result = panel._run_preregistered_panel(m, {'slug': p['slug'], 'attempt': f['pin']}, panel.ask,
                                          LoggedClient(a), receipt_dir=ROOT, receipt_stem='range-endpoints')
    save('panel-result', result)
    save('panel-usage', panel.usage_report())
    if result:
        print('FINAL_RESULT', json.dumps({k: result.get(k) for k in ('value', 'value_lo', 'value_hi', 'arms', 'per_member', 'stratum_results', 'attempt_id')}), flush=True)
    else:
        print('TYPED_PANEL_STOP: inspect official abort receipt.', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    {'qualify': qualify, 'run': run}[sys.argv[1]]()
